en: Determine a company’s tax residence and scope of income
Compute chargeable income from profit before tax
Identify gross business income and allowable, specific, double and prohibited deductions
Apply the carry-forward limits for capital allowances and losses
Apply approved donation rules and the corporate tax rates
ms: Tentukan residen cukai syarikat dan skop pendapatan
Hitung pendapatan bercukai daripada keuntungan sebelum cukai
Kenal pasti pendapatan kasar perniagaan serta potongan dibenarkan, khusus, berganda dan dilarang
Gunakan had bawa ke hadapan bagi elaun modal dan kerugian
Gunakan peraturan derma diluluskan dan kadar cukai korporat

blocks.en: Corporate tax is imposed on resident companies (private and public limited) that earn income in Malaysia and from outside Malaysia.
blocks.ms: Cukai korporat dikenakan ke atas syarikat residen (berhad dan sendirian berhad) yang memperoleh pendapatan di Malaysia dan dari luar Malaysia.

blocks.en: A company is tax resident in Malaysia if its management and control are exercised in Malaysia, normally where the directors’ meetings on management and control are held.
blocks.ms: Syarikat ialah residen cukai Malaysia jika pengurusan dan kawalannya dijalankan di Malaysia, lazimnya di tempat mesyuarat pengarah mengenai pengurusan dan kawalan diadakan.

blocks.en: Foreign-source income
blocks.ms: Pendapatan sumber luar negara

en: From 1 January 2022, income derived from foreign sources and received in Malaysia is taxed in the hands of Malaysian residents
The Schedule 6 para 28 exemption applies only to non-residents
Of foreign income received in Malaysia, the exempt item is foreign dividend income received in Malaysia by a resident company [P.U.(A) 235/2022]
ms: Dari 1 Januari 2022, pendapatan sumber luar negara yang diterima di Malaysia dicukai ke atas residen Malaysia
Pengecualian Jadual 6 para 28 hanya terpakai kepada bukan residen
Pendapatan dividen luar negara yang diterima di Malaysia oleh syarikat residen ialah pendapatan luar negara diterima di Malaysia yang layak dikecualikan [P.U.(A) 235/2022]

blocks.en: Form C: the company return form (slide 6)
blocks.ms: Borang C: borang nyata cukai syarikat (slaid 6)

What is asked

Perkara ditanya

blocks.en: Item 12 is why the SME status on this slide matters: it links to the SME tax rates in the Tax Rates section.
blocks.ms: Item 12 ialah sebab status PKS penting: ia berkait dengan kadar cukai PKS dalam bahagian Kadar Cukai.

blocks.en: Lecturer’s Eco Furniture answer (b): advantages of residence status include access to the SME rates of 15% and 17% (non-residents pay 24%), and tax incentives under the ITA and Promotion of Investments Act (not available to non-residents).
blocks.ms: Jawapan Eco Furniture pensyarah (b): kelebihan status residen termasuk akses kepada kadar PKS 15% dan 17% (bukan residen bayar 24%), dan insentif cukai di bawah ITA dan Akta Penggalakan Pelaburan (tidak tersedia kepada bukan residen).

en: Start: net profit before tax
Add non-allowable expenses; deduct non-business income, double deduction and special deduction
Add balancing charges; deduct capital allowance / balancing allowances = adjusted income
Deduct brought-forward business losses; add other statutory income = aggregate income (after statutory income)
Deduct current-year business loss, pre-operational expenditure, approved donations, zakat (business) = total / chargeable income
ms: Mula: keuntungan bersih sebelum cukai
Tambah perbelanjaan tidak dibenarkan; tolak pendapatan bukan perniagaan, potongan berganda dan potongan khas
Tambah caj imbangan; tolak elaun modal / elaun imbangan = pendapatan diselaraskan
Tolak kerugian perniagaan dibawa ke hadapan; tambah pendapatan berkanun lain = pendapatan agregat (selepas pendapatan berkanun)
Tolak kerugian perniagaan tahun semasa, perbelanjaan pra-operasi, derma diluluskan, zakat (perniagaan) = jumlah / pendapatan bercukai

blocks.en: Slide 4 shows these items in several jumbled boxes. I arranged them to match the order used in the lecturer’s worked answers (adjusted income → statutory income → aggregate income → chargeable income). Treat my ordering as a study aid.
blocks.ms: Slaid 4 menunjukkan item ini dalam beberapa kotak bercampur. Saya susun mengikut urutan jawapan kerja pensyarah (pendapatan diselaraskan → pendapatan berkanun → pendapatan agregat → pendapatan bercukai). Anggap susunan saya sebagai bahan bantu belajar.

blocks.en: Eco Furniture (lecturer’s Q4): adjusted income RM15,540,600 − capital allowance b/f 25,000 − current 120,000 = statutory business income 15,395,600; − losses b/f 20,000 = 15,375,600; + interest 795,000 (dividend exempt) = aggregate income 16,170,600; − donation 15,000 = chargeable income 16,155,600; tax at 24% = RM3,877,344.
blocks.ms: Eco Furniture (S4 pensyarah): pendapatan diselaraskan RM15,540,600 − elaun modal b/h 25,000 − semasa 120,000 = pendapatan berkanun perniagaan 15,395,600; − kerugian b/h 20,000 = 15,375,600; + faedah 795,000 (dividen dikecualikan) = pendapatan agregat 16,170,600; − derma 15,000 = pendapatan bercukai 16,155,600; cukai pada 24% = RM3,877,344.

title.en: Gross Income from a Business Source

blocks.en: Gross income is under sections 22–32 ITA. Business gross income includes:
blocks.ms: Pendapatan kasar di bawah seksyen 22–32 ITA. Pendapatan kasar perniagaan termasuk:

en: Debts for goods sold or services rendered, or property dealt with, in the course of business
Advance payments received for services to be rendered or use of property to be dealt with
Stock in trade withdrawn
Recovery of debts written off where a deduction was made in the adjusted income
Receipts in cash for goods sold or services rendered
Recoveries of business losses (insurance, employee agreement, legal action, other recovery) that were allowed in computing adjusted income (PR 4/2012)
Debts released where a deduction was made in an earlier YA
ms: Hutang bagi barangan dijual atau perkhidmatan diberi, atau harta diurus, dalam perjalanan perniagaan
Bayaran pendahuluan diterima bagi perkhidmatan yang akan diberi atau penggunaan harta yang akan diurus
Stok dagangan yang dikeluarkan
Perolehan semula hutang yang dihapus kira apabila potongan telah dibuat dalam pendapatan diselaraskan
Penerimaan tunai bagi barangan dijual atau perkhidmatan diberi
Perolehan semula kerugian perniagaan (insurans, perjanjian pekerja, tindakan undang-undang, perolehan lain) yang dibenarkan dalam pendapatan diselaraskan (PR 4/2012)
Hutang dilepaskan apabila potongan dibuat dalam YA terdahulu

title.en: Deductions: S33, S34 and Double Deduction
title.ms: Potongan: S33, S34 dan Potongan Berganda

blocks.en: General provision (S33(1))
blocks.ms: Peruntukan am (S33(1))

en: Wages and salaries of employees
Interest on loans or overdrafts used solely for business or to buy business assets
Rent of land or buildings occupied for the business
Repairs of premises, plant, machinery or fixtures, and renewal, repair or alteration of implements, excluding the cost of reconstructing or rebuilding premises of a permanent nature
ms: Gaji dan upah pekerja
Faedah pinjaman atau overdraf yang digunakan semata-mata untuk perniagaan atau membeli aset perniagaan
Sewa tanah atau bangunan yang diduduki untuk perniagaan
Pembaikan premis, loji, jentera atau lekapan, dan pembaharuan, pembaikan atau ubahan perkakas, tidak termasuk kos membina semula premis yang bersifat kekal

blocks.en: Specific deductions (S34)
blocks.ms: Potongan khusus (S34)

en: Translation into or publication in the national language
Provision of library facilities accessible to the public, up to RM100,000
Irrecoverable bad debts written off and specific doubtful trade debts
Employer’s contributions to approved funds or schemes, up to 19% of the employee’s remuneration
Equipment or renovation to assist disabled employees
Revenue R&D related to the business
Child care centre for employees
Musical or cultural group approved by the Minister of Finance
Sponsorship of arts, cultural and heritage activities up to RM1,000,000 (foreign activities up to RM300,000 a year)
Practical training for a resident individual who is not an employee
ms: Terjemahan ke atau penerbitan dalam bahasa kebangsaan
Penyediaan kemudahan perpustakaan yang boleh diakses orang awam, sehingga RM100,000
Hutang lapuk tidak boleh dipungut yang dihapus kira dan hutang ragu khusus perdagangan
Caruman majikan kepada dana atau skim diluluskan, sehingga 19% daripada saraan pekerja
Peralatan atau pengubahsuaian untuk membantu pekerja kurang upaya
R&D hasil berkaitan perniagaan
Pusat jagaan kanak-kanak untuk pekerja
Kumpulan muzik atau kebudayaan diluluskan Menteri Kewangan
Tajaan aktiviti seni, budaya dan warisan sehingga RM1,000,000 (aktiviti luar negara sehingga RM300,000 setahun)
Latihan amali bagi individu residen yang bukan pekerja

blocks.en: Double deduction (S34, 34A, 34B)
blocks.ms: Potongan berganda (S34, 34A, 34B)

blocks.en: Revenue R&D expenditure approved by the Minister of Finance gets a double deduction. A double deduction is also allowed for a resident’s revenue expenditure on a cash contribution to an approved research institute, payment for the services of an approved research institute or approved research company, or payment for the services of an R&D company or contract R&D company (PR 5/2020).
blocks.ms: Perbelanjaan hasil R&D yang diluluskan Menteri Kewangan mendapat potongan berganda. Potongan berganda juga dibenarkan bagi perbelanjaan hasil residen untuk sumbangan tunai kepada institusi penyelidikan diluluskan, bayaran bagi perkhidmatan institusi atau syarikat penyelidikan diluluskan, atau bayaran bagi perkhidmatan syarikat R&D atau syarikat R&D kontrak (PR 5/2020).

en: Prohibited
Detail
ms: Dilarang
Butiran

en: (a) Domestic or private expenses
ms: (a) Perbelanjaan domestik atau persendirian

en: (b) Not wholly and exclusively incurred to earn income
ms: (b) Tidak ditanggung sepenuhnya dan semata-mata untuk memperoleh pendapatan

en: (c) Capital withdrawn or sums used as capital
e.g. purchase of fixed assets, private residence, cars, shares
ms: (c) Modal yang dikeluarkan atau jumlah digunakan sebagai modal
cth. pembelian aset tetap, rumah persendirian, kereta, saham

en: (d) Payments to a non-approved pension / provident fund
ms: (d) Bayaran kepada dana pencen / simpanan tidak diluluskan

en: (e), (g) Qualifying expenditure for Schedule 2, 3 or 4
Claimed through allowances instead
ms: (e), (g) Perbelanjaan layak bagi Jadual 2, 3 atau 4
Dituntut melalui elaun

en: (f) Interest or royalty subject to s109 paid to a non-resident without withholding tax paid on time
Also payments under ss109B / 109F without tax deducted and paid in time
ms: (f) Faedah atau royalti tertakluk s109 dibayar kepada bukan residen tanpa cukai pegangan dibayar tepat masa
Juga bayaran di bawah s109B / 109F tanpa cukai ditolak dan dibayar tepat masa

en: (i) Sums paid to a government for a licence to extract timber from a forest in Malaysia
ms: (i) Jumlah dibayar kepada kerajaan untuk lesen mengeluarkan balak dari hutan di Malaysia

en: (j) Contract payment where s107A withholding tax and penalty has not been paid
ms: (j) Bayaran kontrak apabila cukai pegangan s107A dan penalti belum dibayar

en: (k) Motor vehicle rentals above RM50,000
Above RM100,000 if the vehicle is brand new and costs not more than RM150,000; commercial transport vehicles excluded
ms: (k) Sewa kenderaan bermotor melebihi RM50,000
Melebihi RM100,000 jika kenderaan baru dan kosnya tidak melebihi RM150,000; kenderaan pengangkutan komersial dikecualikan

en: (l) 50% of entertainment expenses

100% allowed for the provisos (i)–(viii), e.g. entertainment of employees (annual dinner, outings, family day), entertainment sold in the ordinary course of business, promotional samples, trade-fair gifts outside Malaysia, public cultural/sporting events (PR 4/2015)
ms: (l) 50% perbelanjaan keraian

100% dibenarkan bagi proviso (i)–(viii), cth. keraian pekerja (jamuan tahunan, lawatan, hari keluarga), keraian yang dijual dalam perniagaan biasa, sampel promosi, hadiah pameran dagang di luar Malaysia, acara budaya/sukan awam (PR 4/2015)

blocks.ms: Slaid menyenaraikan (e) dan (g) dengan perkataan sama, dan melangkau (h). Saya tunjuk seperti diberi.

blocks.en: These come from the PR files in your TAX2 folder and explain the adjustments used in the lecturer’s worked answers.
blocks.ms: Ini datang daripada fail PR dalam folder TAX2 anda dan menerangkan pelarasan yang digunakan dalam jawapan kerja pensyarah.

en: Item
Treatment
ms: Item
Layanan

en: Entertainment (PR 4/2015)

Wholly and exclusively incurred: 50% allowed, but 100% for the provisos of para 39(1)(l) such as employee entertainment. Lecturer’s Eco Furniture: supplier dinners 50% (RM25,000 added back of RM50,000), staff lunches and annual staff trip fully allowed
ms: Keraian (PR 4/2015)

Ditanggung sepenuhnya dan semata-mata: 50% dibenarkan, tetapi 100% bagi proviso para 39(1)(l) seperti keraian pekerja. Eco Furniture pensyarah: makan malam pembekal 50% (RM25,000 ditambah semula daripada RM50,000), makan tengah hari staf dan lawatan tahunan staf dibenarkan penuh

en: Foreign exchange (PR 12/2019)

Revenue and realised: taxable / deductible. Revenue and unrealised: not taxable / deductible. Capital, realised or not: not taxable / deductible. E.g. realised loss on trade debtors allowed; unrealised loss on year-end trade debts added back; realised loss on buying machinery added back
ms: Tukaran asing (PR 12/2019)

Hasil dan telah direalisasi: boleh dicukai / ditolak. Hasil dan belum direalisasi: tidak boleh dicukai / ditolak. Modal, direalisasi atau tidak: tidak boleh dicukai / ditolak. Cth. kerugian direalisasi atas penghutang dagangan dibenarkan; kerugian belum direalisasi atas hutang dagangan akhir tahun ditambah semula; kerugian direalisasi atas pembelian mesin ditambah semula

en: Loss of cash (PR 4/2012)

Theft or embezzlement by an employee is deductible (arising from delegating duties); not deductible where the person is a director or controller. Lecturer’s Styles: Finance Director RM92,000 added back, cashier RM15,000 allowed
ms: Kehilangan wang tunai (PR 4/2012)

Kecurian atau penyelewengan oleh pekerja boleh ditolak (berpunca daripada pemberian tugas); tidak boleh ditolak jika pelaku pengarah atau pengawal. Styles pensyarah: Pengarah Kewangan RM92,000 ditambah semula, juruwang RM15,000 dibenarkan

en: Bad and doubtful debts (PR 4/2019)

A trade debt written off after reasonable recovery steps is deductible; a provision is not an expense, except s34(2) allows a reasonable provision for trade debts estimated irrecoverable (specific). Non-trade debts such as loans to employees or advances are not deductible unless the business is lending. Recoveries of deducted debts are gross income
ms: Hutang lapuk dan ragu (PR 4/2019)

Hutang dagangan dihapus kira selepas langkah pungutan munasabah boleh ditolak; peruntukan bukan perbelanjaan, kecuali s34(2) membenarkan peruntukan munasabah bagi hutang dagangan dianggar tidak boleh dipungut (khusus). Hutang bukan dagangan seperti pinjaman pekerja atau pendahuluan tidak boleh ditolak kecuali perniagaan memberi pinjaman. Perolehan semula hutang yang ditolak ialah pendapatan kasar

en: Repairs (PR 6/2019)
Restoring to the original condition without improvement is revenue; replacing with higher-quality material is an improvement (capital); initial repairs to make an asset usable are capital
ms: Pembaikan (PR 6/2019)

Memulihkan kepada keadaan asal tanpa penambahbaikan ialah hasil; menggantikan dengan bahan berkualiti lebih tinggi ialah penambahbaikan (modal); pembaikan awal untuk menjadikan aset boleh digunakan ialah modal

en: Disabled employees (PR 3/2019)

Remuneration is allowable under s33(1) and an additional deduction equal to it is allowed (employee must meet the PR’s conditions, e.g. OKU card); training a disabled non-employee in an approved programme gets a double deduction
ms: Pekerja kurang upaya (PR 3/2019)

Saraan dibenarkan di bawah s33(1) dan potongan tambahan sama jumlahnya dibenarkan (pekerja mesti memenuhi syarat PR, cth. kad OKU); melatih orang kurang upaya bukan pekerja dalam program diluluskan mendapat potongan berganda

en: Item
Treatment
ms: Item
Layanan

en: Stock withdrawn for own use or gifts (PR 3/2020)

Valued at market value at the time of withdrawal and treated as gross income under para 24(2)(a), not at cost. Example: batik cost RM1,000, market value RM2,000, given as a gift or lucky-draw prize: RM2,000 is gross income
ms: Stok dikeluarkan untuk kegunaan sendiri atau hadiah (PR 3/2020)

Dinilai pada nilai pasaran semasa pengeluaran dan dianggap pendapatan kasar di bawah para 24(2)(a), bukan pada kos. Contoh: batik kos RM1,000, nilai pasaran RM2,000, diberi sebagai hadiah atau hadiah cabutan bertuah: RM2,000 ialah pendapatan kasar

en: Valuation of stock (PR 2/2020)
Cost methods recognised include FIFO and weighted average cost; the method must be applied consistently to opening and closing stock
ms: Penilaian stok (PR 2/2020)
Kaedah kos yang diiktiraf termasuk FIFO dan kos purata wajaran; kaedah mesti digunakan secara konsisten bagi stok awal dan akhir

en: Advance payments (PR 4/2020)
Income from an advance payment under an agreement is gross income under para 24(1)(b) in the year the payer becomes liable to pay, even if the service is rendered in a later year
ms: Bayaran pendahuluan (PR 4/2020)
Pendapatan daripada bayaran pendahuluan di bawah perjanjian ialah pendapatan kasar di bawah para 24(1)(b) pada tahun pembayar menjadi berhutang, walaupun perkhidmatan diberi pada tahun kemudian

en: Local leave passage (addendum to PR 1/2003)

A local leave passage given to an employee is deductible to the employer under proviso (viii) of para 39(1)(l) and not subject to the 50% entertainment rule; the meals and accommodation benefit is excluded from the employee’s income for up to three local passages a year
ms: Tambang cuti tempatan (addendum PR 1/2003)

Tambang cuti tempatan kepada pekerja boleh ditolak majikan di bawah proviso (viii) para 39(1)(l) dan tidak tertakluk kepada peraturan keraian 50%; faedah makan dan penginapan dikecualikan daripada pendapatan pekerja sehingga tiga kali tambang tempatan setahun

en: Pre-operational expenses (PR 11/2013)
Expenses before a business commences are dealt with under Schedule 4B (qualifying pre-operational expenditure, incorporation expenses and approved training); they are not simply deducted under s33
ms: Perbelanjaan pra-operasi (PR 11/2013)
Perbelanjaan sebelum perniagaan bermula dikendalikan di bawah Jadual 4B (perbelanjaan pra-operasi layak, perbelanjaan pemerbadanan dan latihan diluluskan); ia tidak ditolak biasa di bawah s33

blocks.en: Other PR files (R&D PR 5/2020 and 10/2021, arts PR 2/2021, export PR 1/2013) cover specific incentives. Check each PR for the exact rates and conditions when a question names that incentive.
blocks.ms: Fail PR lain (R&D PR 5/2020 dan 10/2021, seni PR 2/2021, eksport PR 1/2013) merangkumi insentif tertentu. Semak setiap PR bagi kadar dan syarat tepat apabila soalan menyebut insentif itu.

en: Unabsorbed capital allowances (from YA2019) can be carried forward for a maximum of 10 consecutive YAs against income from the same business source
Business losses can be set off against all sources in the current year; unutilised losses can be carried forward against income from any business source
ms: Elaun modal tidak terserap (dari YA2019) boleh dibawa ke hadapan maksimum 10 YA berturut-turut terhadap pendapatan sumber perniagaan yang sama
Kerugian perniagaan boleh ditolak daripada semua sumber dalam tahun semasa; kerugian tidak terguna boleh dibawa ke hadapan terhadap pendapatan sumber perniagaan mana-mana

blocks.en: Slide 19 says unutilised losses can be carried forward ‘a maximum period of 7 consecutive YAs (10 years)’, which is internally inconsistent. The lecturer’s file PR 1/2022 states that the period was extended from 7 to 10 consecutive YAs, so use 10.
blocks.ms: Slaid 19 menyatakan kerugian tidak terguna boleh dibawa ke hadapan ‘maksimum 7 YA berturut-turut (10 tahun)’, yang tidak konsisten. Fail PR 1/2022 pensyarah menyatakan tempoh dilanjutkan daripada 7 kepada 10 YA berturut-turut, jadi gunakan 10.

blocks.en: From YA2009 the company limit is 10% of aggregate income.
blocks.ms: Dari YA2009 had untuk syarikat ialah 10% daripada pendapatan agregat.

q.en: When is a company tax resident in Malaysia?
q.ms: Bila syarikat residen cukai Malaysia?

a.en: When its management and control are exercised in Malaysia, normally where directors’ meetings are held.
a.ms: Apabila pengurusan dan kawalannya dijalankan di Malaysia, lazimnya di tempat mesyuarat pengarah diadakan.

q.en: Foreign-source income received in Malaysia from 2022?
q.ms: Pendapatan sumber luar negara diterima di Malaysia dari 2022?

a.en: Taxed in the hands of Malaysian residents.
a.ms: Dicukai ke atas residen Malaysia.

q.en: Who can use the Schedule 6 para 28 exemption?
q.ms: Siapa boleh guna pengecualian Jadual 6 para 28?

a.en: Only persons not resident in Malaysia.
a.ms: Hanya orang bukan residen di Malaysia.

q.en: Chargeable income route?
q.ms: Laluan pendapatan bercukai?

a.en: Net profit → adjusted income → statutory income → aggregate income → chargeable income.
a.ms: Keuntungan bersih → pendapatan diselaraskan → pendapatan berkanun → pendapatan agregat → pendapatan bercukai.

q.en: Adjustments to net profit?
q.ms: Pelarasan kepada keuntungan bersih?

a.en: Add non-allowable expenses; deduct double and special deductions.
a.ms: Tambah perbelanjaan tidak dibenarkan; tolak potongan berganda dan khas.

q.en: Name three business gross income items.
q.ms: Namakan tiga item pendapatan kasar perniagaan.

a.en: Debts for goods/services, advance payments, stock withdrawn, recovery of written-off debts, cash receipts.
a.ms: Hutang barangan/perkhidmatan, bayaran pendahuluan, stok dikeluarkan, perolehan semula hutang dihapus kira, penerimaan tunai.

q.en: Name four S33(1) deductions.
q.ms: Namakan empat potongan S33(1).

a.en: Wages and salaries; business loan interest; rent; repairs (excluding rebuilding of a permanent nature).
a.ms: Gaji; faedah pinjaman perniagaan; sewa; pembaikan (tidak termasuk pembinaan semula kekal).

q.en: Ceiling for employer’s contributions to approved funds?
q.ms: Had caruman majikan kepada dana diluluskan?

a.en: 19% of the employee’s remuneration.
a.ms: 19% daripada saraan pekerja.

q.en: Ceiling for library facilities under S34?
q.ms: Had kemudahan perpustakaan di bawah S34?

q.en: Ceiling for arts, cultural and heritage sponsorship?
q.ms: Had tajaan seni, budaya dan warisan?

a.en: RM1,000,000; foreign activities up to RM300,000 a year.
a.ms: RM1,000,000; aktiviti luar negara sehingga RM300,000 setahun.

q.en: Which R&D expenditure gets double deduction?
q.ms: R&D mana mendapat potongan berganda?

a.en: Approved revenue R&D, and payments to approved institutes / R&D companies.
a.ms: R&D hasil diluluskan, dan bayaran kepada institut / syarikat R&D diluluskan.

q.en: How much entertainment expense is disallowed?
q.ms: Berapa perbelanjaan keraian tidak dibenarkan?

a.en: 50% of entertainment is disallowed (S39(1)(l)), except the provisos allowed in full, e.g. employee entertainment.
a.ms: 50% keraian tidak dibenarkan (S39(1)(l)), kecuali proviso yang dibenarkan penuh, cth. keraian pekerja.

q.en: Motor vehicle rental limit?
q.ms: Had sewa kenderaan bermotor?

a.en: Rentals above RM50,000 disallowed; RM100,000 if the vehicle is brand new and costs up to RM150,000.
a.ms: Sewa melebihi RM50,000 tidak dibenarkan; RM100,000 jika kenderaan baru dan kos sehingga RM150,000.

q.en: Interest or royalty to a non-resident with no WHT paid?
q.ms: Faedah atau royalti kepada bukan residen tanpa WHT dibayar?

a.en: Prohibited deduction (s39(1)(f)).
a.ms: Potongan dilarang (s39(1)(f)).

q.en: Entertainment treatment under PR 4/2015?
q.ms: Layanan keraian di bawah PR 4/2015?

a.en: 50% allowed generally; 100% for the para 39(1)(l) provisos such as employee entertainment.
a.ms: 50% dibenarkan secara am; 100% bagi proviso para 39(1)(l) seperti keraian pekerja.

q.en: Treatment of an unrealised forex loss on trade debts?
q.ms: Layanan kerugian tukaran asing belum direalisasi atas hutang dagangan?

a.en: Not deductible (added back); only realised revenue differences are taxable/deductible.
a.ms: Tidak boleh ditolak (ditambah semula); hanya perbezaan hasil direalisasi boleh dicukai/ditolak.

q.en: Embezzlement by an employee vs a director?
q.ms: Penyelewengan oleh pekerja lwn pengarah?

a.en: Employee: deductible. Director or controller: not deductible (PR 4/2012).
a.ms: Pekerja: boleh ditolak. Pengarah atau pengawal: tidak boleh ditolak (PR 4/2012).

q.en: Deduction for remuneration of disabled employees?
q.ms: Potongan saraan pekerja kurang upaya?

a.en: Allowable under s33(1) plus an additional equal deduction.
a.ms: Dibenarkan di bawah s33(1) ditambah potongan tambahan sama jumlah.

q.en: Stock taken for own use is valued at?
q.ms: Stok diambil untuk kegunaan sendiri dinilai pada?

a.en: Market value at withdrawal, treated as gross income (PR 3/2020).
a.ms: Nilai pasaran semasa pengeluaran, dianggap pendapatan kasar (PR 3/2020).

q.en: Which stock valuation methods are accepted?
q.ms: Kaedah penilaian stok yang diterima?

a.en: FIFO and weighted average cost, applied consistently (PR 2/2020).
a.ms: FIFO dan kos purata wajaran, digunakan secara konsisten (PR 2/2020).

q.en: When is an advance payment taxed?
q.ms: Bila bayaran pendahuluan dicukai?

a.en: When the payer becomes liable to pay, under para 24(1)(b) (PR 4/2020).
a.ms: Apabila pembayar menjadi berhutang, di bawah para 24(1)(b) (PR 4/2020).

q.en: Carry-forward period for unabsorbed capital allowance?
q.ms: Tempoh bawa ke hadapan elaun modal tidak terserap?

a.en: Maximum 10 consecutive YAs, same business source.
a.ms: Maksimum 10 YA berturut-turut, sumber perniagaan sama.

q.en: Carry-forward period for business losses?
q.ms: Tempoh bawa ke hadapan kerugian perniagaan?

a.en: 10 consecutive YAs (extended from 7 by PR 1/2022).
a.ms: 10 YA berturut-turut (dilanjutkan daripada 7 oleh PR 1/2022).

q.en: Limit on donations for companies?
q.ms: Had derma untuk syarikat?

a.en: 10% of aggregate income.
a.ms: 10% daripada pendapatan agregat.

q.en: Public library gift limit under s44(8)?
q.ms: Had hadiah perpustakaan awam di bawah s44(8)?

a.en: RM20,000, with no s34(6)(g) claim on the same expense.
a.ms: RM20,000, tanpa tuntutan s34(6)(g) bagi perbelanjaan sama.
